cities.name: Golden Veld
cities.description: Sun-warmed savanna grass stretches to the horizon; acacia silhouettes and dust haze hold the quiet before a pride moves.

cities.name: Kopje Watch
cities.description: A granite kopje rises from the plain — a natural lookout where leopards read the wind and the veld below.

cities.name: Waterhole Dusk
cities.description: A still waterhole at dusk; muddy banks and golden light — every predator knows who arrives last drinks safest.

cities.name: Monsoon Canopy
cities.description: Teak and fig canopy filters monsoon light; the forest floor waits in humid silence for a tiger to cross.

cities.name: Delta Mist
cities.description: River mist curls through mangrove roots; half-submerged banks hide crocodiles and the patience of ambush.

cities.name: River Crossing
cities.description: A shallow ford cuts the delta; dappled water and reeds frame the moment before a strike from the bank.

cities.name: Granite Ridge
cities.description: Wind-scoured granite ledges above Patagonian steppe; a puma's territory written in scent along the stone.

cities.name: Ember Coast
cities.description: Volcanic coast at crimson dusk; surf mist and basalt cliffs — harpy eagles read thermals above the tide.

cities.name: Canopy Shadow
cities.description: Dappled jungle shadow on a forest floor; jaguar rosettes dissolve into leaf-filtered ember light.

cities.name: Boreal Silence
cities.description: Snow-dusted pines under pale arctic light; wolf tracks cross the trail and vanish into white quiet.

cities.name: Snow Ridge
cities.description: An alpine snow ridge at blue hour; snow leopard territory marked in prints along a narrow ledge.

cities.name: Eagle Thermals
cities.description: Open sky above boreal forest; golden eagles ride cold thermals while the taiga waits below.
